description.text: Program Description Sociology majors are trained to have comprehensive theoretical knowledge of sociology and more skilled social investigation skills. Able to conduct social research and investigation in education, scientific research institutions, party and government institutions, enterprises and institutions, and social organizations. It also trains senior professionals in policy research and evaluation, social planning and management, development research and forecasting. Duration 4 years

duration.text: The Sociology at Tongji University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above
